name: PartOf
description: A part of a larger whole: a department or branch of an organization, a district of a city.

relation.reads: Logistics is part of Acme — the part is the subject
relation.how_many: One whole at a time on the part's end: a department belongs to one division, and moving it is a handover. The whole's end is not limited — a company has as many departments as it has.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What the user calls this relation, in their words.

what_to_say: in what sense one is part of the other
